name: NotForProfitNonCommercialUseOnly
summary: The card component of Not-for-Profit, Non-Commercial Use Only (DUO_0000018). The requester's legal form is one the owner treats as not-for-profit, and an intended use names no purpose the owner treats as commercial. Decides about the requester.

nonprofitLegalForms.description: ISO 20275 ELF codes the data owner treats as not-for-profit; a LegalDesignationCredential qualifies if its hasLegalForm is in this list. If the key is missing, nothing qualifies and access is denied.

prohibitedPurposes.description: Purpose terms, as they appear in IntendedDataUseCredential.useOnlyFor.purposes, that make a use commercial; at least one presented IDU must contain none of them. If the key is missing, nothing qualifies and access is denied.
